text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, Maya and I watched a drama 
together that she was curious about.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I was only gonna watch one episode, but 
then Mayano said she knew who the first 
culprit was, so we watched till the end, 
and she was actually right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd give it a shot too, and 
we both started guessing the culprits one 
after another until it got super fun...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I ended up watching the whole thing after 
all~... *yawn*
